about_the_game:
RPG CHESS - A TURN-BASED RPG, EXCEPT IT'S ALSO CHESS!

Step into a world where every move is a potential battle for glory! RPG Chess reimagines the classic game of chess as an epic turn-based RPG adventure, combining strategy, combat, and other beloved RPG elements in a way you've never experienced before.

FEATURES:

  • Strategic Chess Gameplay with an RPG Twist:
    Every attack initiates a battle! Instead of capturing pieces, you’ll enter intense 1v1 combat sequences where your piece must fight for victory. The outcome depends on your strategy, piece level, and skill in battle. While the attacker gets the first move, the targeted piece finally gets to fight back!

  • Piece Progression and Leveling:

    Each time a piece moves, fights, or secures victory in combat, it gains valuable experience points. Level up your pieces to unlock stronger abilities and stat boosts, transforming even a humble pawn into a mighty warrior. You choose which stats and abilities you want to prioritize on each level up, allowing you to craft the perfect balance of units for your strategy!

  • Dynamic Elements:

    As your pieces claim new abilities, their element type may also change as a result. A piece's element type is based on the majority of its abilities' elements, and each element type has its own strengths and weaknesses. Gain combative advantages by performing elemental transformations to fit the situation on the board!

  • Battle Your Friends:

    Challenge your friends to intense 1v1 matches online or gather around for local multiplayer-mode. Outsmart, outplay, and outlast in the ultimate face-off—whether you're across the internet or side by side.

  • Immersive Single-Player Roguelike:

    Lead your pieces through a grand journey across diverse boards and environments in the King's Gauntlet. Face off against procedurally generated opponents and challenging bosses, each encounter demanding strategic mastery and adaptability. As you progress, your pieces retain their levels and abilities, creating unique synergies and powerful builds with every run. Use your gold earned from battles to attain powerful items and pieces. Every attempt in King's Gauntlet offers a fresh opportunity to forge an unstoppable team!

  • Customize Your Pieces:

    Express the personality of your army with a variety of customization options. Unlock unique hats to give each piece extra flair, and give them personal nicknames to make every battle feel uniquely yours.

BUILD YOUR ARMY. MASTER THE BOARD. EXCEL IN COMBAT.

Forge your path as a tactician and warrior in RPG Chess. Every move shapes your pieces, and every battle brings you closer to triumph.

Ready to experience chess in an exciting new way? Add RPG Chess to your wishlist today!
